[spoiler=The Election Ends, and Anarchry Begins][b][i]Western View Paper, Front Page[/i][/b]
Today the results from the election are in, and Mack Messiaon has won, as predicted. Mack has run for Head Council for 11 years, and 10 of them were against his younger brother Tony. Mack has already gone into action, banning any protests, and forcing anyone between the ages of 18 and 65, without a disability, to join the army, but mothers with children under the age of 16 are allowed to stay until their children come of age. Mack has also banned all forms of non-government media, as well as bringing back the death penalty and the torture penalty. This has come to shock to many because he said he would do anything to protect the citizens of Western View, but in previous campaigns he said he would protect the rights of Western View, thus he could be considered a liar. This shall be the last edition of the magazine before Mack Messiaon bans our paper.

[b]The Western View Paper, Page 2[/b]
Yesterday, not only were Wessernian and Kolionian jets stolen, Hatzur Zatsugi pretended to be the government in a letter and claimed that he stole the jets, also, rioters from Eastornia-Kolionia broke into the capital and stormed the place, many government officials and police men were hurt. Also many protesters had signs saying "Hatzur Zatsugi is better than you fools" or "Get the foreigners out" in fact their was one sign saying "We support Hatzur Zatsugi". This is most likely the reason why Mack Messioan banned public protests, though it really is only cause more violent protests, and many of the conscripted, and some no conscripted units have walked away from their training camps, or other bases, to apparently join Hatzur Zatsugi. The known number of people supporting Hatzur Zatsugi has risen from 13,000 to 26,000, and people estimate that there are over 40,000 people supporting Hatzur.[/spoiler]

[quote=roskesak;60063019][i][u][b]The Embassy Hostage Crisis
[/b][/u]
Smoke rolls above the rooftops. The crowds are gone. The only movement is that of the joint team of snipers, entrenched in their rooftop positions, awaiting the order.
KGI Commander was approached again by the two ISRP officers. One older, stoic, the other younger and serving as translator.

[b]KGI Commander
[/b] Youve already crossed the border with armed units and armored vehicles. Youd better explain who the hell authorized you.

The younger operative steps forward, showing a black enamel badge. 

[b]ISRP Translator[/b]
 We operate under the interlaw jurisdiction of international criminal enforcement. Were here to assist with the hostage embassy crisis.

You stiffen. That changes the calculus.  Interlaw jurisdiction gives them operational legitimacy barely, but your streets, your command still stands.

[b]KGI Commander[/b]
 You track terrorists. I protect hostages. You can observe. You can advise. But this op remains under Roskeskan control.

The ISRP nods. No argument. Theyre trained for cooperation. The older operative pulls up a portable interface. It's already displaying live internal security feeds from the embassy, marked in Roskeskan. Your intel division mustve cracked the feeds minutes ago.

[b]ISRP Agent[/b]
 Two confirmed militants. First floor in the west hallway. One has a homemade explosive vest, likely a dead-man switch. Theyve barricaded the lobby and jammed some camera access. But not all.

Footage shows one is pacing with a rifle, the other glued to the windows*

[b]KGI Commander[/b]
 The ISRP orders that we lure them in.

officers pause in confusion?*

[b]ISRP Agent[/b]
Make it look like we think there are more inside. Get loud. Shout false numbers. Act disorganized. Let them think were blind and paranoid.

You gesture to your rooftop units.

When the first pokes his head through the curtains, and drops him. Quietly. The second one will panic. Thats when we breach.

A joint special forces unit of KGI and ISRP sniper chimes in through the radio* 

Visual confirmation possible from roof 3A. Awaiting movement.

You nod. The trap is set.[/i][/quote]
